newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Police capture two Russian cadets who killed six.
newsitem.headline: Police capture two Russian cadets who killed six.

text.p: Two students at a Russian military college who fled after shooting dead five fellow cadets and an instructor early on Sunday gave themselves up to police and troops who tracked them down, a local police officer said.
"Thank god, we got them, no shots fired," the officer said by telephone from Volgograd, 900 km (600 miles) southeast of Moscow.

One of the two cadets opened fire on colleagues standing guard at Kamyshin Military College north of Volgograd early on Sunday, killing five fellow students and an instructor and seriously wounding two other cadets.
The two assailants, about 18 years old, then fled with two submachineguns and ammunition.
They were tracked down and surrounded in a house belonging to the relatives of one of them and were eventually persuaded to hand themselves over to the police, ending a 12-hour search operation.
"We had to ask their next of kin for help to get them to surrender. Apparently everything worked out fine", the police officer said. He could not give any reason for the shooting.
